_about: Where Mr.BiZ sources are, for the addon's BiZNav arrow (Alt + click on a BiZ row). Keyed by what build_bis.py reads from a source: the instance name (dungeon rows), the vendor's name (text before the first comma of a vendor label) or the faction (reputation rows). Same point format as launch-plan-waypoints.json: zone = English zone name (resolved to a uiMapID in game, mapHint only a hint), x/y in map percent, label, conf: 'exact' (Forever source), 'classic' (Classic position of a place that still exists; may have moved in Forever), 'approx' (rough spot). Quests and world drops get no place (no position in our data). Researched 2026-10-13.

_sources.wiki: warcraft.wiki.gg / wowpedia: Shadowfang Keep 45,68; Gnomeregan 24,40; Illiyana Moonblaze 61.5,83.9; Samuel Hawke stands in Refuge Pointe
